notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR16 allocates an output CD area of "(10 plus (13 times integer-1))" positions: count 9(4), text length 9(4), status XX, then integer-1 occurrences of error key X and destination X(12). CommunicationFormats.OutputHeader/OutputEntry and BuildArea build exactly that implicit record (an OCCURS group only with DESTINATION TABLE, else the 23-position flat area of SR11), and CommunicationArea.DestinationCapacity reads integer-1 back from the area's width. Probes at 85: layout and ref-mod bounds with OCCURS 2 (36 positions), unsigned truncation (-5 -> 0005, 123456 -> 3456), a shorter redefining record, OCCURS 0, a clause twice, a Format 1 clause, a series, no clause and no record, a duplicate data-name (all refused), and BINARY-CHAR in the record (2002, refused); the witness checks the 23- and 49-position images.

next.reason: 1985: "a record area of 23 contiguous character positions is allocated for each output CD"; 2023: "No candidate covers the communication description entry; the Communication module is absent from 2023.". No 2023 clause holds the CD feature and no wording candidate covers output CD record areas. 2023 lacks the communication module, so the rule is dropped.
